name: Skyworks Solutions, Inc.
summary: Skyworks Solutions, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and markets analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products and solutions in the United States, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers amplifiers, antenna tuners, attenuators, automotive tuners and digital radios, wireless ASoC, DC/DC converters, demodulators, detectors, digital power isolators, diodes, directional couplers, diversity receive modules, filters, front-end modules, hybrids, light emitting diode drivers, low noise amplifiers, mixers, modulators, and optocouplers/optoisolators.
